title: backlog.py's host and user name check exempts the project's own repository path
goal: backlog.py check does not refuse an item for spelling the project's repository path (namespace/project, and its URL-encoded form namespace%2Fproject) even when the namespace equals this host's user name: the paths are read at run time from the git remotes' URLs (never spelled in code), occurrences of them are removed from an item's text before the name match, and the user name elsewhere in the text is still refused. The operator decided the exemption (2026-09-30).
